description: List the recipients this company cannot reach: protected global invalid-recipient suppressions for addresses associated with the company, protected workspace hard bounces without conclusive invalid-inbox evidence, removable workspace soft-bounce escalations, and protected spam complaints. Each row includes a stable suppressionType, and the response echoes the applied sortBy/sortOrder. Sort by `status` to surface the suppressions you can actually remove. Start here when a customer reports missing email; use get_recipient_suppression for one exact address.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

limit.description: Entries per page. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

order.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `desc` for suppressedAt and status, `asc` for email.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the recipient email address.

sort.description: Order the page. `suppressedAt` (default) is newest first, `email` is A-Z, and `status` lists removable workspace escalations before protected suppressions. An unrecognized value falls back to `suppressedAt`.

name: list_recipient_suppressions

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_recipient_suppressions` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sortBy.description: Sort field actually applied: suppressedAt, email or status. An unrecognized `sort` falls back to suppressedAt, so read this rather than assuming the requested order took effect.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction applied: asc or desc.

suppressions.description: List of suppressed recipient, with suppressionType, reason, scope and whether it can be removed records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

total.description: Total suppressed recipients matching the filter.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
